answers.question: In Cretan-hieroglyphs, what material can I report for CHIC-252?
answers.finding: Report an unresolved material disagreement: CHIC1996, printed p. 252, #252 material caption, says “Ivoire” (ivory); INSCRIBE-CH, General information / Material, says “Animal bone”. The catalogue dossier repeats the latter as source-reported metadata, not an adjudicated material identification. Its linked closure control explicitly sets resolved_material=null and single_material_value_admitted=false. The association uses the CHIC heading, CMS II.1,393 and inventory stem 2266 (HM 2266 versus Σ-K 2266), without independent physical-identity certification.
limits: The repository records prior primary-page and digital-page inspection; I retrieved those records rather than inspecting the original pages anew.
The dependent digital readings and primary numerical matches do not adjudicate material or establish independent witnesses.
Material adjudication and independent physical-identity certification remain absent. No images or models were redistributed; upstream component terms remain applicable.

answers.question: In Byblos-syllabary, can printed ordinal 32 be used as an unambiguous sign-type lookup?
answers.finding: No. Coverage discovery exposes catalogue, survey-count-assertions, attribution-review and closure-controls collections. The exact closure-controls record BYB-A-D1930-ordinal-032 preserves two printed memberships, VIII and XIX, at Dunand1930 p. 5 (numbering convention p. 4). The actual type-table rows list 32 under VIII and XIX; XIX also preserves a parenthetical marker at 32. The control sets unambiguous_printed_type=null and source_table_lookup_admitted=false, with exclusion_reason=CONFLICTING_PRINTED_MEMBERSHIPS. The suggested 32-to-92 correction has not been adopted.
limits: This concerns Dunand1930 stele A printed numbering, not a corpus-wide ordinal namespace.
Printed memberships are source assertions, not certified ancient occurrences, canonical sign identities or verified sequences.
The original printed page was not freshly inspected in this run.
commands_executed: Python json/pathlib traversal of research/stele-a-type-table.json, selecting rows labelled VIII and XIX; SHA-256 calculated with hashlib.sha256

answers.question: Does Linear-B source-study record LB-ANNOTATION-ACQUISITION-20261017 establish that linguistic calibration has been executed?
answers.finding: No. The source-study record explicitly says calibration_executed=false. It acquired 26 live identity records, comprising 25 selected pilot records and one published example, while same-snapshot word crosswalk, linked linguistic annotations and certified graphical baseline remain unacquired. Later evidence preserves that distinction: the 19 October public-route inspection did not deliver a linked annotation package or same-snapshot crosswalk. The 25 October printed-appendix recheck confirmed three document fields and seven publication-local units (five lexical words, one logogram, one numeral), but explicitly retained calibration_executed=false, linguistic_gold_acquired=false and same_version_word_crosswalk_verified=false.
limits: Publication facts, public endpoint availability and identity consistency are not aligned linguistic gold or executed calibration.
The study review status is PREPARED_NOT_REVIEWED; source authorship does not establish project participation or acceptance.
The inspected records do not establish global absence of annotations from every DĀMOS route.
This run inspected frozen native records, not private authenticated payloads or the original publication afresh.
